content: systemd user unit recipe for daemons: [Unit] + [Service] Type=simple (foreground, never fork or append & to ExecStart — immediate exit looks like failure and loops), Restart=on-failure (restarts only on non-zero exit), RestartSec=5, optional StartLimitIntervalSec=300+StartLimitBurst=5, [Install] WantedBy=default.target; install via systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now <unit>; user services stop at last logout unless loginctl enable-linger $USER (systemd v230 behavior; spawns user manager at boot). reset-failed clears a hit start limit. User=/Group= meaningless in user units; %h = home.
